description: Paraphrased Cosy Hub/Pod status guidance, used for free-text keyword retrieval when an installer's symptom carries no formal fault code (n8n 'Retrieve Manual Context' node). See README.md for source and copyright notes.

entries.summary: A steady yellow hub light usually means lost WiFi, not a broken unit - check the router is powered on; the hub auto-reconnects once WiFi is back.
A steady red hub light typically means the primary room sensor for a heating zone has dropped off - check its battery and proximity to the hub, or promote another sensor to primary.
A slow-flashing red light on a room sensor is usually just a low battery, not a fault - replace with two fresh AAA batteries first.
A flashing red light on the hub itself (not a room sensor) is documented as an actual unit fault, not a connectivity problem - treat as hardware and escalate.
